sites.name: map-main — site name (mostly the business on the site) as the map popup title; 3,799 distinct values, no aggregate view
sites.address: chart-towns, insight:town — town derived from the address prefix; the street address itself isn't charted (free text, 2,775 distinct values)
sites.gush: skip: cadastral block number, 55% empty; an identifier, not an analytical dimension
sites.helka: skip: cadastral parcel number, 56% empty; an identifier
sites.date: chart-updates, insight:updates, kpi:recent — the row's last-update date
sites.link: skip: constant — the same gov.il guide URL on every row
